title: The Lantern Festival Planning Meeting · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: Last week, a group of neighbours met in the community hall. They were planning a lantern festival for the town. Mrs Chen was leading the meeting. While she was writing notes on the board, Mr Li arrived with a box of old lanterns. "These are from my grandfather," he said. "He was a lantern maker." The group needed a theme. A young woman named Anna suggested "Stories of Our Town." Everyone liked the idea. They decided to ask people to make lanterns about local people. One lantern would show the baker who opens his shop at 5 a. m. Another would show the nurse who works at the small clinic. Mrs Chen said, "We need a place for the event." Mr Li said the park was free on Saturday. While they were talking, the town librarian came in. She offered to display old photos of the town. The group was happy. They planned to meet again on Thursday.
